mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the position information route to the guided arm was most worthwhile: it connected muscle sensing to the familiar experience of moving with closed eyes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the visual route to the control system felt predictable after making the route, though it made the connection explicit.

surprise.text: The distinction between light reaching the retina and a signal traveling along a sensory nerve changed how I pictured the visual route.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each combination a recognizable purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the guided arm becomes part of a working body. The connections were clear, although the choices in this chapter were fairly predictable.
